package fuzzy

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestZZDump(t *testing.T) {
	in := os.Getenv("DUMP_IN")
	if in == "" {
		t.Skip()
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(in)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var doc struct {
		Entries map[string]any `json:"entries"`
		Queries []string       `json:"queries"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &doc); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var ix Index
	ix.Update(snapOf(t, doc.Entries))
	m := NewMatcher()
	type hitOut struct {
		Path       string `json:"path"`
		Score      int    `json:"score"`
		OnKey      bool   `json:"onKey"`
		Spread     bool   `json:"spread"`
		ValueAt    int    `json:"valueAt"`
		KeyMarks   []int  `json:"keyMarks"`
		ValueMarks []int  `json:"valueMarks"`
	}
	out := map[string][]hitOut{}
	for _, q := range doc.Queries {
		var hs []hitOut
		for _, h := range ix.Query(m, q) {
			text := valueText(mustRaw(doc.Entries[h.Entry.Path]))
			hs = append(hs, hitOut{h.Entry.Path, h.Score, h.OnKey, h.Spread, h.ValueAt, h.KeyPositions(m, q), h.ValueMarks(m, q, text, 0)})
		}
		out[q] = hs
	}
	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", " ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("DUMP_OUT"), b, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func mustRaw(v any) json.RawMessage {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(v)
	return b
}
